# Phase 01.1 — UI Design Contract

> Visual and interaction contract. Generated by gsd-ui-researcher, verified by gsd-ui-checker.
> **This contract supersedes `01-UI-SPEC.md`'s Design System / Typography / Color / Spacing sections
> for every surface in the repo.** `01-UI-SPEC.md`'s Copywriting Contract and UI Considerations are
> *carried forward and extended* here, not replaced.

---

## Scope Note

01.1 is an enabling phase. It delivers no requirement ID. It produces three things:

1. **The token layer** — Cena's product brand as the single styling source of truth, namespaced
   against a venue-themable contract that nothing in v1 consumes (D-02 revised, D-14).
2. **The primitive layer** — 19 re-skinned/added Radix primitives carrying the Cena visual language.
3. **The diner design vocabulary** — the patterns phases 2–7 render against, so they adopt rather
   than invent (SC5).

**Read `01.1-CONTEXT.md` § "Scope decision, 2026-08-04" before this file.** D-02 was *reversed*:
**v1 ships exactly one brand — Cena's — on every surface, diner included.** Venue theming is a later
milestone. Any agent designing a venue-branded diner menu in v1 is designing the wrong product.

### Three source documents are wrong in ways this contract corrects

| Source | Wrong claim | This contract |
|---|---|---|
| Objective brief / `codebase_context` | "The imported design system bundle lives at `ds-bundle/`" | **False.** `ds-bundle/` is the design-sync *push* bundle of the repo's **current/old** layer — Inter, `#16A34A` green, shadcn semantic roles. Its `tokens/` and `guidelines/` directories are **empty**. Verified this session. The imported Cena system lives only in cloud project `07b799d4-de60-4b17-8aec-106904d0b264`, partially mirrored at `.planning/research/design-system-mirror/`. `ds-bundle/_screenshots/*.png` photograph the layer this phase deletes. |
| `01.1-RESEARCH.md` § Pattern 3, `contrast.ts` snippet | `0.0722 * (n & 255)` | **Bug — the blue channel is never linearised.** Copying it yields `contrastRatio("#000000","#FFFFFF") === 387.78`, not 21. Verified by execution this session. See `## Contrast Guardrail Contract`. |
| `qr-menu/README.md` | "Allergens are the EU set" | **False — 7 of 14.** See `## Diner Design Vocabulary` § Allergens. |

## Design System

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Tool | **shadcn** — already initialized. `components.json` exists and is read, not regenerated. |
| Preset | `style: radix-nova`, `baseColor: neutral`, `cssVariables: true`, `rsc: true`, `iconLibrary: lucide`, `registries: {}` |
| Component library | **Radix** (`radix-ui ^1.6.7`) — behaviour layer, kept. The imported system's hand-rolled JSX primitives carry no focus management, keyboard nav or ARIA and are **visual reference only, never shipped code** (audit D-2). |
| Icon library | `lucide-react ^1.27.0` at **`strokeWidth={1.75}`** (not Lucide's stock 2). Do not add a second icon set — the imported system's 50 glyphs *are* Lucide. |
| Font — display/serif | **Newsreader** — `--font-serif`. Variable (`opsz` 6–72, `wght` 300–700). OFL 1.1, no reserved name. |
| Font — body/sans | **Instrument Sans** — `--font-sans`. Variable (`wdth`, `wght` 400–700). OFL 1.1, no reserved name. |
| Font — numeric/mono | **IBM Plex Mono** — `--font-mono`. **Not variable — `weight: ["400","600"]` is REQUIRED or the build errors.** OFL 1.1, **reserved font name "Plex"**. |
| Font delivery | **`next/font/google` with `subsets: ["latin","latin-ext"]`.** Self-hosts at build; zero runtime request to Google. `latin-ext` is verified codepoint-by-codepoint to cover every RO (`ă â î ș ț`) and HU (`ő ű`) diacritic in all three families. |

### Font rules — three that are load-bearing, not preferences

1. **🚫 `tokens/fonts.css` MUST NOT be migrated.** It is three lines and its payload is
   `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?…')`. An instruction to "adopt `tokens/*.css`",
   read literally, **regresses SC1 on its own**. Any task whose action reads "copy `tokens/` across"
   without a written exclusion list is defective.
2. **No custom subsetting pipeline.** `pyftsubset`/fontTools are not installed, and a self-produced
   subset of IBM Plex Mono is an OFL "Modified Version" that may not carry the "Plex" name. Shipping
   Google's own official `latin-ext` build through `next/font` sidesteps the licence question entirely.
3. **Italic is a byte-budget decision, not a detail.** The imported system requests italic for
   Newsreader and Instrument Sans; the diner surface uses italic in exactly one place (the venue's
   descriptive aside). Requesting italic doubles the file count per family per subset, on the DINE-03
   critical path. **Contract: ship roman only. Restyle the venue aside as Body in `--font-serif` at
   weight 400.** Revisit only against a measured Phase 2 font budget.

### SC1's literal wording is already false — allowlist, do not narrow

SC1 says "no third-party font **or asset** request on any page". `app/(auth)/components/GoogleOneTap.tsx:422`
loads `https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client`. That is **ACCT-01, a shipped feature, not an oversight.**

**Contract:** the SC1 tripwire is an **allowlist with exactly one entry**, carrying its ACCT-01
justification inline. Any new external origin fails the test until it is added *with a reason*.
Do not narrow the check's scope until it stops being able to fail — a green tripwire that cannot
fail means nothing.

## Spacing Scale

Declared values (every value a multiple of 4):

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| xs | 4px | Icon gaps, inline padding |
| sm | 8px | Compact element spacing, form field gaps, chip padding |
| md | **16px** | Default element spacing, card padding, diner row padding |
| lg | 24px | Section padding, diner section breaks |
| xl | 32px | Layout gaps, desktop page margins |
| 2xl | 48px | Major section breaks |
| 3xl | 64px | Page-level spacing |
| touch | **44px** | Hard floor for **every** interactive control on **every** surface |

**The scale is unchanged from `01-UI-SPEC.md` and must stay unchanged.** Two values are pinned
literally by `tests/lib/theme-width-scale.test.ts`: **`--spacing-md: 16px`** and
**`--spacing-touch: 44px`**. Changing either changes an existing test's meaning and violates SC2.

### Exceptions

- **Touch floor is now universal, not tablet-only.** `01-UI-SPEC.md` applied the 44px floor to the
  `(tablet)` route group only. SC3 extends "usable one-handed on a phone" to *every* owner surface,
  and the diner menu is phone-only by definition. **Every button, chip, pill, checkbox, switch, tab,
  select trigger and menu row has a ≥44px hit area on every surface.**
  This resolves RESEARCH Open Question 6 and it is **Wave 1 (token) work, not Wave 4 (surface) work** —
  deciding it in Wave 4 makes it a rework of every screen.
- **`radix-nova` primitives ship 24–36px controls (`h-6`/`h-7`/`h-8`/`h-9`, `size-6`…`size-9`).
  Every one is below the floor.** The re-skin must raise the default or add a phone size. This is
  real design work; a plan that treats it as a token swap is under-scoped.
- **Display-only elements are exempt** from the 44px floor: PIN dot indicators (12px, 8px gaps),
  allergen/dietary chips that are *not* filter controls, status badges, the sold-out badge.
  *A dietary filter chip is a control and is not exempt.*

### The one hard constraint on the token layer

Tailwind v4 resolves `max-w-*` as `--max-width → --spacing → --container`. **`--spacing` outranks
`--container`**, so a `--spacing-<name>` that collides with a Tailwind container name silently
redefines `max-w-<name>`. This already shipped once as a defect: `max-w-md` compiled to `16px`,
and because `Card` is `overflow-hidden`, the login form was clipped out of both paint *and*
hit-testing — present, enabled, invisible, unclickable.

**Contract: for every `--spacing-<k>` added, add matching `--max-width-<k>` and `--min-width-<k>`
carrying Tailwind's stock container value.** `tests/lib/theme-width-scale.test.ts` computes the
colliding-key set dynamically and will name the missing key.

## Typography

**Exactly four size roles. Exactly two weights. This rejects the imported system's scale.**

| Role | Size | Weight | Line Height | Family | Used for |
|------|------|--------|-------------|--------|----------|
| Body | 16px | 400 | 1.5 | `--font-sans` | Body copy, dish descriptions, form inputs, banner copy |
| Label | 14px | 600 | 1.4 | `--font-sans` | Form labels, buttons, chips, badges, eyebrows, count lines, allergen chips |
| Heading | 20px | 600 | 1.2 | `--font-serif` | Dish names, section headings, card titles, dialog titles |
| Display | 28px | 600 | 1.2 | `--font-serif` | Venue name, page titles, the "Cena" wordmark |

**Two weights across the entire product: 400 (regular) and 600 (semibold). Never a third.**

### Family axis — orthogonal to size, adds no sizes

`--font-mono` (IBM Plex Mono) carries **numerics and machine-ish strings only**: prices, macro
values (kcal/protein/carbs/fat), service hours, table eyebrows, PIN digits, device codes. It renders
at the Label or Body role, never at a size of its own. This is the imported system's own convention
and it is what makes a price column align.

### Why the imported system's scale is rejected

`QrMenu.dc.html` uses **seven** scale steps (`--text-2xs` … `--text-xl`) plus four raw literals
(`10px`, `17px`, `24px`, `29px`). That is eleven type sizes on one screen. The repo has four roles,
pinned by an approved contract. **Collapse to four.** Concretely:

| Template | Maps to | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `--text-2xs`, `--text-xs`, `10px` | **Label 14px** | See below — this is the accessibility fix, not a rounding |
| `--text-sm`, `--text-base` | Body 16px | |
| `17px`, `--text-md`, `--text-lg` | Heading 20px | Dish names gain 3px; correct on a 520px column |
| `24px`, `29px`, `--text-xl` | Display 28px | |

**Raising 10px type to 14px is the single highest-value accessibility decision in this phase.**
RESEARCH § Pattern 3 identifies `--text-subtle` on `--surface-sunken` at `--text-2xs` as
simultaneously (a) the lowest-contrast pair on the diner surface, (b) the smallest type, and
(c) **the surface carrying allergen chips** — the one display PROJECT.md names as legally
load-bearing. Ten-pixel type carrying EU allergen information is a defect. The 4-role collapse
removes the failure mode at the root rather than tuning a hex value to survive it.

### `--type-label` / `--type-eyebrow` are CSS `font:` shorthands — decompose them

The imported system declares these as `font:` shorthand values (`font: var(--type-label)`).
**Tailwind v4 has no theme namespace for the `font` shorthand**, so they cannot become utilities.
Decompose each into its `--text-*` + `--font-weight-*` + `--tracking-*` triple. An eyebrow is
Label + `--tracking-caps` + `text-transform: uppercase` + `--font-mono` — not a fifth role.

## Color

Cena's product brand — the Szeged-derived palette (D-01), adopted with the ramp values **measured
and locked below**. v1 renders every surface in this palette, diner included (D-02 revised).

| Role | Value | Usage |
|------|-------|-------|
| **Dominant (60%)** | `#FFFFFF` | Page background, card surfaces, form surfaces, the diner menu column |
| **Secondary (30%)** | `#EDF2F1` (`tisza-100`) | Sidebar/nav, sunken surfaces, table stripes, tiles, disabled states, the page field behind the 520px diner column |
| **Accent (10%)** | `#0B5FA5` (`szeged-700`) | See "Accent reserved for" — deliberately narrow |
| **Destructive** | `#B3261E` (`paprika-600`) | Destructive actions and error state only |

### Full locked ramp

| Token | Hex | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `--cena-paper` | `#FFFFFF` | Dominant surface |
| `--cena-surface-sunken` | `#EDF2F1` | Secondary surface (tisza-100) |
| `--cena-surface-chip` | `#DCE4E3` | Chip / badge / placeholder surface (tisza-200) |
| `--cena-rule` | `#DCE4E3` | **Decorative** dividers only — WCAG 1.4.11 exempt |
| `--cena-border-control` | `#7C8B89` | **Control boundaries** — inputs, checkboxes, idle chips (tisza-400) |
| `--cena-ink` | `#1C2625` | Headings, dish names, prices (tisza-900) |
| `--cena-ink-body` | `#3F4D4B` | Body copy (tisza-700) |
| `--cena-ink-muted` | `#526260` | Descriptions, hours, count lines, **allergen chips** (tisza-600) |
| `--cena-accent` | `#0B5FA5` | Primary fill, accent text, focus ring (szeged-700) |
| `--cena-accent-pressed` | `#084B83` | Hover / pressed (szeged-800) |
| `--cena-accent-soft` | `#EAF2F9` | Accent-tinted surface (szeged-50) |
| `--cena-warning-soft` | `#FBE6A8` | Napfeny band / "Now" badge fill (napfeny-200) |
| `--cena-warning-border` | `#9A6F08` | Napfeny rule (napfeny-700) |
| `--cena-warning-ink` | `#4A3204` | **Text on napfeny is always this** (napfeny-900) |
| `--cena-danger` | `#B3261E` | Destructive text and fill (paprika-600) |
| `--cena-danger-soft` | `#FCEDEC` | Destructive-tinted surface (paprika-50) |

**There is no `subtle` ink token.** The imported system's `--text-subtle` is used 14 times, always
at 10px, and is the origin of the worst contrast pair in the system. **It collapses into
`--cena-ink-muted`.** Three ink values, not four.

**No interactive control renders on `--cena-surface-chip`.** `--cena-border-control` clears 3:1 on
paper (3.55) and on sunken (3.14) but not on chip (2.75). Controls sit on paper or sunken only.
This is an enforceable layout rule, not a caveat.

### Accent reserved for

- The **single** primary CTA on a screen — "Create your account", "Create venue", "Add staff member",
  "Enable staff mode", "Publish menu"
- The active/selected nav item in the owner sidebar
- The active category chip and active dietary filter on the diner menu
- The selected variant row in the item sheet
- The "Clear filters" text link
- The focus ring (3px `--cena-accent` at 30% alpha)
- The pressed state of a PIN key (momentary)

**Azure appears once per view as the primary action.** A screen with two azure *buttons* is wrong.

**Accent is NOT used for:** icons in general, links in body copy, secondary/tertiary buttons,
status badges, sold-out badges, allergen or dietary chips, or any destructive control.

### The napfeny rule — a second accent under a hard cap

Gold is capped at **≈5% of any screen, and is never a surface.** In v1 it appears in exactly two
places, and a third is added by this phase:

1. The "Now" badge on the currently-live menu (MENU-09) — one per screen.
2. The DINE-04 last-good/offline banner.
3. **The unverified-AI-field marker (INGEST-04/06)** — see Diner Design Vocabulary.

**Text on napfeny is always `--cena-warning-ink` `#4A3204`.** Never black, never the body ink.

### Status colours are Cena-fixed, and stay Cena-fixed when venue theming ships

Resolves RESEARCH Open Question 8. Warning, danger and success are **never venue-themable**, on any
surface, ever. A warning that reads as a warning is a safety affordance — sold-out, allergen,
stale-menu, unverified-AI — and a venue that themes it can accidentally make it invisible. Because
status colours will eventually sit on venue-controlled paper, **every status pair is a permanent
row in the contrast sweep** (rows 11, 17, 18 below), not a v1-only check.

### Dark mode

Token definitions are kept; **no dark UI is wired** (D-10). No `prefers-color-scheme` selector may
reach a `--venue-*` token — auto-darkening would invalidate every ratio measured below. Whether a
Cena-branded diner menu should ever honour `prefers-color-scheme` is an **open question with no
standing answer**, flagged to the theming milestone.

## Contrast Guardrail Contract

SC4's proof. All values below were **executed, not asserted**, this session.

### The reference implementation in `01.1-RESEARCH.md` has two defects — do not copy it

| # | Defect | Symptom | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `0.0722 * (n & 255)` — the **blue channel is never linearised** | `contrastRatio("#000000","#FFFFFF")` returns **387.78**, not 21. Every ratio involving blue is inflated — including every pair against `--cena-accent`, which is azure | All three channels pass through the linearisation function |
| 2 | `parseInt(hex.replace("#",""),16)` **silently mis-parses 3-digit hex** | `contrastRatio("#000","#fff")` returns 2.51 | Input must be 6-digit `#rrggbb`. **3-digit shorthand throws, it does not coerce** |

Both defects fail *open* — they report contrast that does not exist, on a gate PROJECT.md makes
legally load-bearing. **The oracle assertions below are the contract that catches them.**

### Mandatory oracle pins

`tests/theme/venue-contrast-guardrail.test.ts` MUST assert these literal values before it asserts
anything about the palette. A refactor of the luminance maths fails here, not silently downstream.

| Input | Required output |
|---|---|
| `contrastRatio("#000000", "#FFFFFF")` | `21.00` |
| `contrastRatio("#767676", "#FFFFFF")` | `4.542` (±0.005) — the canonical AA near-pass |
| `contrastRatio("#777777", "#FFFFFF")` | `4.478` (±0.005) — the canonical AA near-fail |
| `contrastRatio("#fff", "#000")` | **throws** — 3-digit input is rejected, not coerced |

### The sweep — 18 real co-occurrence pairs, measured

Every pair is a genuine co-occurrence read from `QrMenu.dc.html` or a shipped Phase 01 surface.
This is an **adjacency list, not a cartesian product** — a cartesian sweep asserts nonsense
(accent-ink on paper never co-occurs).

| # | Foreground | Background | Threshold | Measured | Renders at |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `ink-body` | `paper` | 4.5 | **8.84** | Body copy |
| 2 | `ink` | `paper` | 4.5 | **15.52** | Dish names, headings, prices |
| 3 | `ink-muted` | `paper` | 4.5 | **6.41** | Dish descriptions |
| 4 | `ink-muted` | `surface-sunken` | 4.5 | **5.67** | Service hours, count line, eyebrow |
| 5 | `ink-muted` | `surface-chip` | 4.5 | **4.96** | **Allergen chips (DINE-06) — the historic worst pair** |
| 6 | `paper` | `accent` | 4.5 | **6.57** | Primary button, active category chip |
| 7 | `accent` | `accent-soft` | 4.5 | **5.81** | Dietary chips, active filter |
| 8 | `accent` | `surface-sunken` | 4.5 | **5.81** | Selected variant row |
| 9 | `accent` | `paper` | 4.5 | **6.57** | "Clear filters" link |
| 10 | `ink-body` | `surface-sunken` | 4.5 | **7.82** | Hovered rows |
| 11 | `warning-ink` | `warning-soft` | 4.5 | **9.71** | **DINE-04 last-good banner — release gate** |
| 12 | `ink` | `surface-sunken` | 4.5 | **13.72** | Nutrition values |
| 13 | `ink-body` | `surface-chip` | 4.5 | **6.84** | Sold-out note (MENU-10) |
| 14 | `rule` | `paper` | **exempt** | 1.29 | Decorative divider — WCAG 1.4.11 exempts pure decoration |
| 15 | `border-control` | `paper` / `surface-sunken` | **3.0** | **3.55 / 3.14** | Input, checkbox, idle chip boundaries |
| 16 | `accent` | `paper` | **3.0** | **6.57** | Focus ring, selected-state border |
| 17 | `warning-border` | `warning-soft` | **3.0** | **3.65** | Banner rule |
| 18 | `danger` | `paper` / `danger-soft` | 4.5 | **6.54 / 5.75** | **Unverified-AI-field marker (INGEST-06) — release gate** |

**Rows 14–17 carry the 3:1 non-text threshold (WCAG 1.4.11). Applying 4.5:1 uniformly produces
false failures and is how a guardrail gets weakened until it passes.**

**Result: 0 failures across 22 evaluated pairs.**

### Adversarial rejections — a guardrail that has never refused anything is untested

| Input | Must be | Measured |
|---|---|---|
| `#FFFFFF` on `#FFFFFF` | rejected | 1.000 |
| `#0B5FA5` on `#0B5FA5` | rejected | 1.000 |
| `#777777` on `#FFFFFF` (4.48 near-miss) | rejected | 4.478 |

### Non-vacuity control

Assert `CONTRAST_PAIRS.length >= 8`, following the idiom `theme-width-scale.test.ts` already uses.
A sweep that silently empties is a green test that proves nothing.

### If the Wave-1 `tokens/colors.css` fetch returns different ramp values

The exact ramps in the cloud project were **not retrievable this session** — the researcher has no
`DesignSync` tool and the project is authenticated. The **one** value confirmed from source is
`--szeged-700 #0B5FA5`, and it is used verbatim above. Every other value here was derived to satisfy
(a) the imported system's stated character — tisza is a cool green-grey neutral anchored on the
documented shadow tint `rgba(54,66,65,…)`, napfeny is gold, paprika is red — and (b) the measured
sweep.

**Contract for the fetch:** an imported ramp value may replace a value above **only if the full
sweep and all four oracle pins stay green.** The guardrail is the arbiter, not the source document.
A fetched value that fails the sweep is a defect in the imported system, and this phase's job is to
correct it — that is precisely what SC4 exists for. **Do not weaken a threshold to accommodate an
imported hex.**

## Token Namespace Contract

The D-14 boundary. Built in 01.1; **nothing in v1 consumes the venue half.**

| Layer | Prefix | Set by | On diner surface in v1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cena product brand | `--cena-*` | Cena, fixed | **Yes** — v1 ships one brand (D-02 revised) |
| Cena structure | `--spacing-* --radius-* --text-* --ease-* --duration-*` | Cena, fixed | **Yes — and immutable by a venue, forever** |
| Venue skin | `--venue-*` | a venue, within guardrails | **No consumer in v1.** Fallbacks only |

### Rules

1. **`@theme inline` is mandatory for every venue-themable token.** Without `inline`, Tailwind emits
   `var(--color-x)` where `--color-x: var(--venue-ink)` resolves in `:root`'s scope, and a nested
   override on the menu root is **ignored**. This is the documented scope-resolution failure `inline`
   exists to fix.
2. **The venue namespace carries hex only** (`#rrggbb`). It is what a colour picker produces, it is
   what WCAG 2.1's relative-luminance formula is defined over, and it removes any colour-space
   conversion dependency from inside a legal release gate. Cena's own tokens may use any notation.
3. **No Cena ramp identifier may appear in `app/tokens/venue.css`** — no `--szeged-*`, `--napfeny-*`,
   `--paprika-*`, `--tisza-*`. Greppable, and `tests/theme/token-boundary.test.ts` asserts it.
4. **No surface consumes a raw ramp name — only semantic names.** The imported template leaks
   `--tisza-100` and `--tisza-200` directly onto the diner page background and the placeholder
   stripes. Under the revised D-02 that is no longer a brand breach, but it is still the structural
   failure the contract exists to prevent: **a raw ramp name can never be re-mapped by a theme.**
   Normalise all five usages to `--cena-surface-sunken` / `--cena-surface-chip`.
5. **Venue theme values reach CSS via a `style` prop on the diner page's root Server Component**,
   baked at prerender. Never a `<style dangerouslySetInnerHTML>` (string-interpolation injection
   surface), never middleware (forces the route dynamic), never a client fetch (forbidden by
   CLAUDE.md, and causes FOUC on the DINE-03 critical path).
6. **Font pairings are a closed set of statically-declared `next/font` instances**, selected by class
   name. `next/font` resolves family names at build time; a dynamic family name cannot work. This is
   the mechanical reason the curated-set shape is the only implementable one.

**19 primitives, not 16.** SC2's "all 16" understates the surface by three and overstates the
net-new work by two.

| Primitive | Today | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `button` | ✅ | **Re-skin** + raise sizes to the 44px floor |
| `card` `badge` `input` `checkbox` `dialog` `label` | ✅ | **Re-skin** |
| `sonner` | ✅ | **Re-skin.** This **is** the imported system's `Toast` — `radix-nova/toast.json` returns 404. Do not replace it |
| **`alert` `avatar` `dropdown-menu`** | ✅ | **Re-skin — the imported system's 16 never names these**, and all three ship in Phase 01 surfaces. Leaving them produces a visibly mixed system |
| `select` `radio-group` `switch` `field` `tabs` `tooltip` | ❌ | **`shadcn add`** + re-skin. All six declare `cssVars: false` — none mutates `globals.css` |
| `separator` | ❌ | Transitive via `field` |
| **`IconButton`** | ✅ | **NOT net-new** — it is `Button size="icon"`, already shipped in four sizes |
| **`Icon`** | ❌ | Hand-author: a ~15-line wrapper pinning `strokeWidth={1.75}` |
| **`Tag`** | ❌ | Hand-author, or a 7th `Badge` variant. No Radix behaviour involved |

```bash
pnpm exec shadcn add select radio-group switch field tabs tooltip
```

### Re-skin rules that a careless pass breaks

The Phase 01 suite couples to **accessible names, roles and source shape — not to classes.** A grep
of all 47 files for `className` / `toHaveClass` / Tailwind prefixes returns seven lines in one file.
So a class-only change cannot break a behavioural test, and a red during the re-skin is a **real**
signal. What *will* break:

- **Never remove or rename a `<Label htmlFor>` or `aria-label` while restyling.**
- **Keep Radix `data-state` semantics.** A re-skin styles `data-checked`; it does not replace the
  state model.
- **Do not wrap the `(dashboard)/layout.tsx` create-venue `<Link>` in any conditional, ternary or
  `&&`** — even for layout. `tests/lib/unconditional-cta-coverage.test.ts` walks ancestors.
- **Keep the native `<select>` in `venue-form.tsx`.** `radix-nova/select` is a styled listbox; the
  native control opens the OS picker, which is strictly better one-handed (SC3), and swapping it
  breaks `venue-form-languages.test.tsx`'s `select.options` reads (SC2). Adopt `Select` only where a
  listbox is genuinely required.
- **`shadcn add field` pulls `label` as a registry dependency and `components/ui/label.tsx` already
  exists.** Run with an explicit overwrite policy and diff it afterwards — an unattended overwrite
  silently reverts a documented workaround.
- **Do not push a Server Component to the client.** Adding a `Tooltip` or hover hook to
  `DashboardNav` / `VenueSwitcher` / `(dashboard)/layout.tsx` requires `"use client"`, which moves a
  Supabase read to the browser. Keep interactive leaves in their own client components — the
  `VenueSwitcher` (server) → `venue-switcher-menu.tsx` (client) split is the pattern to follow.
- **Do not alter the shared signup/login error string or the consent-gate ordering.**
  `COPY.errors.auth` is deliberately ambiguous to resist account enumeration.

## Diner Design Vocabulary

SC5. The patterns phases 2–7 render against. **`QrMenu.dc.html` is a spec to re-implement, never
code to port** — it is authored in another runtime (`<x-dc>`, `<sc-if>`, `<sc-for>`,
`x-import`), uses inline `style=` throughout with not one Tailwind class, and carries non-standard
attributes that exist only in that runtime.

### Shell

One column, `max-width: 520px`, `min-height: 100dvh`, centred on `--cena-surface-sunken`, column on
`--cena-paper`. Sticky category rail offset 108px for the sticky header. Mobile-first; a tablet gets
the same column, not a second layout.

### The three photo states (THEME-03)

**A factual correction to CONTEXT.md D-08:** D-08 states the template "renders every image as a
labelled striped placeholder" in the zero-photo state. **Reading the source, it does not.** With
`photos: 'none'`, `showCover` is false and `wantsPhoto()` returns false unconditionally — no cover,
no 68px row thumb, no 186px sheet image, **no placeholder at all**. D-08's "no image slot — not a
wash, not a stripe, nothing occupying where a photo would be" is **already satisfied**.

**D-08's design conclusion still stands, for a different reason.** The zero-photo state is the photo
layout *minus the photo* — identical row height, padding, type scale and section rules, with the
right column simply collapsing to the price. That is a subtraction, not a design.

| State | Contract |
|---|---|
| **none** (the common case) | A **genuinely different, typographic layout.** Dish name in `--font-serif` at Heading, description at Body in `ink-muted`, price in `--font-mono`, allergen chips, `lg` (24px) row rhythm instead of `md`, full-width text column, no image slot and no reserved space. Rationale is PROJECT.md's, verbatim: "empty image slots look worse than a design that never expected them." Most independent restaurants have no photography — **this is the default, not the degraded mode.** |
| **some** | **Named as work, and currently unsolved.** `wantsPhoto()` returns `Boolean(item.photo)`, so rows alternate between having and not having a thumb, producing a ragged right edge with nothing reconciling it. THEME-03 names "some photos" explicitly and it is the hardest of the three to make look intentional. **Contract: photos are a per-section property, not a per-item one** — a section renders in photo layout only if every item in it has a photo; otherwise the whole section renders in the zero-photo layout. This makes "some" a composition of two solved states rather than a third unsolved one. |
| **full** | Cover 136px; 68px row thumb at `--radius-md`; 186px sheet image with `--radius-sheet` top corners. |

### Item detail sheet (DINE-05)

**Re-implement on Radix `Dialog` (`components/ui/dialog.tsx`). Take the visuals only.** The
template's sheet is a bare `div` with backdrop-click-to-close: no `role="dialog"`, no `aria-modal`,
no focus trap, no Escape handler, no focus restore, no accessible name.

Visuals to keep: bottom-anchored, `max-width: 520px`, `max-height: 88dvh`, `--radius-sheet` on the
top corners only, `--shadow-xl`, `backdrop-filter: blur(3px)` over the overlay, a 16px rise-in and a
fade. **Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`, which the template does not.**

Content order: image (if any) → dish name (Heading, serif) → description (Body, muted) → variants →
price → nutrition → allergens → disclaimer.

**Variants:** selectable rows, `1.5px` border, selected state on `--cena-accent-soft` with
`--cena-accent` border. **The sheet's headline price updates from the selected variant.**

**Nutrition:** a 4-up grid — kcal, protein, carbs, fat — each value in `--font-mono` over an
uppercase Label.

### Category rail

Derived from **non-empty** sections, so applying a dietary filter changes which categories exist and
**the rail can reflow under the diner's finger.** Defensible, but a deliberate choice, not an
inherited one. **Contract: the rail renders all sections and greys out empty ones rather than
removing them.** A rail that reflows mid-tap is a mis-tap.

### Last-good / offline state (DINE-04, D-07)

**The template's copy is wrong in three ways and must not be carried.** It reads "You are seeing the
saved menu. Prices refresh as soon as you are back online." — which (a) carries no timestamp, (b)
omits the sold-out warning, and (c) **describes the wrong failure model.** The architecture is ISR
stale-serve: the page was prerendered and served from the edge, and what failed is *background
regeneration*, not the diner's connection. **The diner may be perfectly online.** A string telling
them to reconnect is misleading and implies an auto-refresh the page does not perform.

**Visual treatment (adopt as-is):** full-width, above the cover, **non-dismissible**,
`--cena-warning-soft` background, `--cena-warning-border` bottom rule, `--cena-warning-ink` copy, a
16px `info` icon, one sentence at Body.

**The timestamp must be real.** The template's `updatedLine` is the hardcoded literal `4 · 8 · 19:04`
— the footer *looks* like it shows freshness and does not. Phase 2 must carry a genuine
`generatedAt` from the prerender. **The honest staleness signal is prerender age, not
`navigator.onLine`.**

### Language (LANG-05, LANG-06)

**The detection *policy* transfers; the *mechanism* does not.** Reading `navigator.languages` on
first paint is incompatible with a prerendered, CDN-served page: it yields either a flash of the
**entire menu** in the wrong language on exactly the poor connection DINE-03 guards, or a
client-rendered page, which CLAUDE.md forbids.

**Contract:**
- **One static page per (venue, language): `/menu/[slug]/[lang]`**, `generateStaticParams()` over
  the venue's enabled languages. Every rendered page stays fully static.
- `/menu/[slug]` negotiates `Accept-Language` as a **307 in `proxy.ts`**, which runs before the
  cache and does not de-optimise the destination. The template's matching policy ports verbatim —
  iterate the client's *ordered* preference list, normalise each tag to its lowercased 2-char
  prefix, return the first in the supported set, else `en`. Ordered-preference matching is the part
  usually got wrong.
- **The QR payload encodes the venue's default language** (`/menu/[slug]/[defaultLang]`), so the
  common case never redirects. This resolves RESEARCH Open Question 9, is free if decided now and a
  migration if decided later, and constrains the URL shape DINE-01 generates.
- **LANG-06 falls out for free:** the pills become `<Link>`s to a sibling static URL. "For the rest
  of the visit" is carried by the URL — surviving reload, back/forward and sharing — with **zero
  storage, zero cookie, zero consent question.** The template's in-memory `state.lang` does not
  survive a reload, so its README's claim is false.

**Fixes on the way through:** pills use **endonyms — Magyar / English / Română — not 2-letter
codes.** A diner who cannot read the current language cannot decode "HU". Wrap in `role="group"`
with an accessible label and `aria-current="true"` on the active pill; the template has none of it.
Pills sit at 48px tall, above the fold, directly under the venue name.

### Allergens and dietary tags (DINE-06) — legal weight

**The template ships 7 of the 14 EU allergens, and its README's claim "Allergens are the EU set" is
false.** Present: gluten, milk, eggs, fish, nuts, celery, sulphites. **Missing: crustaceans,
peanuts, soybeans, mustard, sesame, lupin, molluscs.**

**Contract: the vocabulary is the full Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Annex II set of 14 categories,
authored in 01.1 in hu/en/ro, with `peanuts` a key distinct from `nuts`.** Peanut is among the most
severe allergens and is a separate Annex II category precisely because tree-nut avoidance does not
imply peanut avoidance. Cena's obligation is not to *declare* allergens — the restaurant does that —
it is to **not make compliance structurally impossible**, and a 7-value vocabulary means a
restaurant serving prawns, satay, hummus or mussels physically cannot declare them.

This resolves RESEARCH Open Question 7: **vocabulary in 01.1** (14 keys × 3 languages is a copy
artifact and exactly what SC5 asks for), **filtering in Phase 3**. Leaving it to Phase 3 repeats the
pattern D-06 was written to prevent — a legal gate invented under time pressure.

Assert `ALLERGENS.length === 14` with the Annex II reference in the failure message, and assert
`peanuts` and `nuts` are distinct keys.

**Display:** allergen chips at **Label (14px)**, `ink-muted` on `surface-chip` — measured 4.96:1.
Never 10px. Dietary tags as uppercase Label chips on `accent-soft`.

**The always-present disclaimer stays, in all three languages.** It is exactly the posture the EU-FIC
constraint requires — the obligation sits with the restaurant.

**Dietary filtering** (adopt as-is, it is the best-designed interaction in the template): three
chips, **AND** semantics, ≥44px targets in both states, a check icon on the active chip, a running
count line, and a "Clear filters" action that appears only when filters are active.

**Filtering *by allergen* is net-new** and not in v1 — DINE-06's "filter **or** identify" is
satisfied by identification. Note it as the more useful interaction for an allergic diner if a later
phase wants it.

### Sold-out (MENU-10)

Adopt as-is — it is right. Sold-out items **stay listed**, carry a neutral-tone badge, **remain
tappable**, and the sheet carries a note saying what to do instead. Hiding them is worse: a diner
who came for that dish learns nothing. Both the badge and the note are deliberately **quiet** —
a sold-out dish is information, not an error, so neither uses `--cena-danger`.

### "Now" badge (MENU-09)

Adopt the treatment; **derive the value server-side at prerender from the venue's timezone.**
`now: true` is a hardcoded literal on the dinner menu with no clock read anywhere in the template —
copying it ships a badge that says "Now" at 4am. The initially-selected menu is likewise hardcoded.
`hours` is a display string, not a schedule.

### Currency (ACCT-02)

**Use `Intl.NumberFormat`, not the template's `money()`.** What the template gets *right* — and what
settles audit warning W-3 — is that **formatting is per-currency, not one continental rule.** The
imported `readme.md` mandates "Continental decimal comma; €148,50" globally, which is wrong for
zero-decimal HUF; the template contradicts its own readme, and **the template is right.**

| Currency | Locale | Renders |
|---|---|---|
| HUF | `hu-HU` | `148 500 Ft` — zero decimals |
| RON | `ro-RO` | `1.903,85 lei` — **`currencyDisplay: "narrowSymbol"` is REQUIRED**, or it renders "RON" |
| EUR | `de-DE` | `20,26 €` |

**Do not port:** the hardcoded FX rates (venues store one currency each), or
`Math.round(huf/10)*10`, which is a pricing decision masquerading as formatting. Note that
`Intl` emits `7900 Ft` where the template emits `7 900 Ft` — ICU's `minimumGroupingDigits` for
`hu-HU`. A real, visible divergence: pin it with a literal-string test, since ICU data shifts
between Node majors.

Prices render in `--font-mono` at the Heading role.

### Unverified-AI-field marking (INGEST-04/06)

**Owner-side, not diner-side.** The diner never sees an unverified field — an unverified field
cannot be published. **ROADMAP SC5 lists this under the *diner menu's* vocabulary; that is a
drafting error** (D-06 notes it). D-06 honours SC5's intent by defining the marking state at the
token/primitive level here, because it is a legal release gate, it is cheap to define once, and
leaving Phase 7 to invent it under time pressure is how that gate gets done badly.

**Contract:** the marker is a **napfeny `Tag`** — `--cena-warning-soft` fill, `--cena-warning-border`
1px rule, `--cena-warning-ink` Label text, with a 14px `alert-triangle` icon. It attaches to the
*field*, not the row, and it counts against the 5% napfeny cap. The publish action is **disabled
while any unverified field remains**, with the count surfaced in the blocking copy. Confirmation is
**per field** — never a bulk "confirm all", which defeats the requirement.

### What the template does NOT cover — carry this list forward, not the README's claim

The template README self-declares 11 requirement IDs. Verified against source: **1 holds, 10 partial,
0 outright false.** The pattern is consistent — every claim confined to *diner-side display* holds;
every claim reaching into an owner surface, persistence, or architecture does not, because a static
template structurally cannot carry those.

| Req | Verdict | Residue owed to a later phase |
|---|---|---|
| DINE-05 | **HOLDS** | Accessibility only (Radix `Dialog`) |
| DINE-02 | partial | Slug→venue resolution, published-vs-draft gate, unknown-venue/table states, QR payload format → **Ph 2** |
| DINE-04 | partial | Real `generatedAt`, D-07 copy, staleness signal → **Ph 2** |
| DINE-06 | partial | **The 14-allergen vocabulary → 01.1**; filtering → **Ph 3** |
| MENU-08 | partial | Owner menu CRUD → **Ph 2** |
| MENU-09 | partial | Schedule data model (start/end/days/timezone), owner UI, server-side "live now" derivation → **Ph 3** |
| MENU-10 | partial | Owner/staff toggle + `revalidatePath` propagation → **Ph 2** |
| LANG-05 | partial | Mechanism replaced entirely (routing, not `navigator`) → **Ph 5** |
| LANG-06 | partial | URL-carried persistence, endonyms, group semantics → **Ph 5** |
| THEME-03 | partial | Zero-photo as a *design*; **the `some` state** → **Ph 4** |
| ACCT-02 | partial | `Intl` formatting → 01.1; owner surface already shipped |

**Do not convert a template README's self-report into settled fact.** That is the failure mode D-05
exists to catch, and it is how the false allergen claim nearly entered the product.

## Copywriting Contract

Voice **register kept verbatim** (D-04): calm floor manager, second person, active present, sentence
case, no emoji; errors state what happened then what to do; confirmations past tense with undo.

**Lexicon re-cut (D-04) is almost entirely a design-project edit, not a repo edit.** A grep of
`lib/`, `components/`, `app/`, `actions/` and `01-UI-SPEC.md` for *covers, turns, the pass, fired,
86'd, the book, walk-in, close out* returns 16 matches — **all ordinary English in code comments**
("this covers the unauthenticated case", "the idle timer fired"). **Zero user-visible strings use
restaurant jargon.** The dropped lexicon lives in the imported `readme.md` § Content fundamentals
and its four worked examples, which is a `DesignSync` write-back, not a codebase sweep.

`lib/copy.ts`'s house rule holds: **a user-visible string with no contract row is a signal that the
design has no screen for that state**, not licence to invent one inline. Every row below must land
in `lib/copy.ts` (or its diner-side equivalent) before its surface ships.

### Carried forward from `01-UI-SPEC.md` — unchanged

| Element | Copy |
|---------|------|
| Primary CTA — signup | "Create your account" |
| Primary CTA — venue creation | "Create venue" |
| Primary CTA — provision staff | "Add staff member" |
| Primary CTA — enable staff mode | "Enable staff mode" |
| Empty state — staff list | **"No staff yet"** — "Add your first staff member so they can start toggling item availability from the floor." — CTA: "Add staff member" |
| Empty state — device registry | **"No devices enrolled"** — "Enable staff mode on a tablet in your restaurant to get started." — CTA: "Enable staff mode" |
| Error — signup/login | "That email or password isn't right. Check and try again, or reset your password." *(deliberately ambiguous — enumeration resistance. The lexicon re-cut must not soften it.)* |
| Error — venue creation | "Something went wrong creating your venue. Check the details and try again." |
| Error — PIN entry | "Wrong PIN. Try again." / "Too many attempts. Try again in {N}s." |
| Error — generic/network | "Something went wrong. Please try again." |
| Destructive — revoke device | "Revoke this device?" — "Staff on this tablet will be signed out immediately and won't be able to toggle availability until re-enabled." — Confirm: "Revoke device" |
| Destructive — deactivate staff | "Deactivate {name}?" — "Their PIN will stop working immediately. This can't be undone, but their past activity stays on record." — Confirm: "Deactivate" |
| Consent capture | "I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy" — required, unchecked by default |

### The six owed rows (D-04, from `01-UAT.md`) — closed by this phase

`01-UAT.md` records the blocker: "`01-UI-SPEC.md` is a checker-approved artifact that plan 01-17
does not own and has not edited." **01.1 owns it.** Editing `01-UI-SPEC.md` here is intentional and
authorised — a verifier should not read it as an out-of-scope edit.

| # | Key | Copy |
|---|-----|------|
| 1 | `COPY.venues.createFirstHeading` | "Add your first venue" |
| 2 | `COPY.venues.createFirstBody` | "You can add more venues later, and change any of this in settings." |
| 3 | `COPY.venues.createAnotherHeading` | "Add another venue" |
| 4 | `COPY.venues.createAnotherBody` | "Each venue keeps its own menu, staff and devices. You can change any of this in settings." |
| 5 | `COPY.consent.googleGate` | "Accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to continue with Google." |
| 6 | `COPY.errors.googleUnavailable` | "Google sign-in isn't available right now. Use your email and password, or try again." |

**Also remove the four "no contract row, and deliberately so" doc comments** in `lib/copy.ts` (at
`googleUnavailable`, `accountSetupIncomplete`, `venues.*`, `consent.googleGate`) once these land —
otherwise the file documents a divergence that no longer exists.

### New — diner vocabulary, all three languages

**D-07 last-good banner — replaces the template's string entirely**

| Lang | Copy |
|---|---|
| en | "Saved menu from {HH:mm}. Prices and sold-out dishes may have changed." |
| hu | "Mentett étlap, {HH:mm}-tól. Az árak és az elfogyott fogások változhattak." |
| ro | "Meniu salvat de la {HH:mm}. Prețurile și felurile epuizate s-ar putea să se fi schimbat." |

*Timestamped and specific, per D-07. It serves PROJECT.md's named risk — "a diner orders something
that has been off for a month and credibility is gone." A bare "Saved menu" cannot distinguish five
minutes from five weeks. It states what happened, then what it means, and it makes no false promise
about reconnecting.*

**Language detection disclosure** — lifted verbatim from the template, which got this right

| Lang | Copy |
|---|---|
| en | "Set from your phone's language. Change it whenever you like." |
| hu | "A telefonod nyelvét használjuk. Válts, amikor szeretnél." |
| ro | "Am folosit limba telefonului tău. Schimbă când vrei." |

**Allergen disclaimer — always present, never dismissible**

| Lang | Copy |
|---|---|
| en | "Allergen details come from the kitchen. Tell your server if you have an allergy." |
| hu | "Az allergénadatokat a konyha adja meg. Kérdezz a pincértől, ha allergiád van." |
| ro | "Informațiile despre alergeni vin de la bucătărie. Spune-i ospătarului dacă ai o alergie." |

**Empty allergen state** — an explicit empty state, not a blank line

| Lang | Copy |
|---|---|
| en | "No allergens marked." |
| hu | "Nincs jelölt allergén." |
| ro | "Niciun alergen marcat." |

**Sold-out note (MENU-10)**

| Lang | Copy |
|---|---|
| en | "Gone for tonight. Your server can suggest something close." |
| hu | "Ma már elfogyott. A pincér tud hasonlót ajánlani." |
| ro | "S-a terminat pentru seara asta. Ospătarul îți poate recomanda altceva." |

**Empty filter state (DINE-06)**

| Lang | Heading / Body |
|---|---|
| en | "Nothing matches that filter yet." / "Drop one filter, or ask your server — the kitchen can adapt more dishes than the menu shows." |
| hu | "Ehhez a szűréshez most nincs fogás." / "Vedd le az egyik szűrőt, vagy kérdezd a pincért — a konyha sok fogást át tud alakítani." |
| ro | "Nimic nu corespunde filtrului." / "Renunță la un filtru sau întreabă ospătarul — bucătăria poate adapta mai multe feluri." |

**Also lift from the template** (same provenance, same treatment): `soldOut`, `nowOn`, `clear`,
`sizes`, `nutrition`, `allergens`, `priceLabel`, `updated`, `close`, `kcal/protein/carbs/fat`, and
the pluralised `showing(a,b)` count line.

> ⚠ **Translation status.** The HU/EN/RO strings lifted from the template read as idiomatic and were
> authored alongside HU-first menu content, but **no native speaker has reviewed them.** Treat as a
> strong starting point requiring review, not as final copy. The three D-07 strings above are
> newly authored here and carry the same caveat.

### New — unverified-AI-field marking (INGEST-04/06)

| Element | Copy (en) |
|---|---|
| Field marker tag | "Unverified" |
| Marker helper | "Filled by AI. Check it before you publish." |
| Publish blocked | "{N} allergen and macro fields still need checking. Confirm each one to publish." |
| Per-field confirm | "Confirmed" *(past tense, per the register)* |

### Destructive actions in this phase

01.1 ships **no new destructive action.** It re-skins two existing ones (revoke device, deactivate
staff), both already contracted above with confirm dialogs. **Their copy, their confirm-button
labels and their dialog ordering must not move during the re-skin.**

## UI Considerations

Covers the elements **this phase introduces**. Phase 01's eleven elements (E1–E11) remain covered by
`01-UI-SPEC.md` § UI Considerations, which the re-skin must not invalidate — every row there is a
behavioural claim, and the re-skin changes appearance only.

Computed by `ui-consideration-probe.cjs` over the 15 surfaces this phase describes (E1–E15), relevance-filtered
by element kind. **110 applicable considerations: 79 covered, 22 backstop, 8 dismissed, 1 unresolved.** Zero
`unclassified` — every element matched at least one kind cue.

**Kind-confirmation caught one recall gap.** The prose classifier read E12 (dashboard / venue switcher / nav)
as `nav` + `interactive-control` only. It is also a `list-collection` — the dashboard lists venues and the
switcher is a venue list — and adding that kind raised `empty`, `populated`, `partial` and `zero-one-many`,
which is how the **zero-venue dashboard state** entered this table. A single tripped cue is a signal, not proof.

| Category | Element | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|---------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | E1 diner menu — item list | ✅ covered | Dietary filter yielding no matches renders the documented empty-filter heading + body in all three languages (Copywriting Contract). A menu with zero items is unreachable — Phase 2's published-vs-draft gate |
| loading | E1 diner menu — item list | ✅ covered | Prerendered and CDN-served — there is no client fetch to show a spinner for. **Any skeleton on this surface is a defect** |
| error | E1 diner menu — item list | ✅ covered | ISR stale-serve means the failure mode is a *stale* page, not an error page — surfaced by E4's banner, never a blank or errored menu |
| populated | E1 diner menu — item list | ✅ covered | Sections render all categories; sticky rail at 108px offset; `lg` (24px) row rhythm zero-photo, `md` photo |
| partial | E1 diner menu — item list | ✅ covered | Photos are a **per-section** property: a section renders in photo layout only if every item in it has a photo, else the whole section renders zero-photo. Removes the ragged right edge |
| overflow | E1 diner menu — item list | ✅ covered | One column, `max-width: 520px`, `min-height: 100dvh`; content scrolls vertically, never clips |
| zero-one-many | E1 diner menu — item list | 🧪 backstop | { statement: "The `showing(a,b)` count line pluralises correctly at 0, 1 and many in all three languages — Hungarian takes no plural agreement after a numeral, so an en-derived plural rule is wrong there", verification: backstop } |
| long-text | E1 diner menu — item list | 🧪 backstop | { statement: "Dish and venue names wrap to a second line rather than truncating — a diner must be able to read the whole dish name", verification: backstop } |
| empty | E2 category rail | ✅ covered | The rail renders all sections and **greys out** empty ones rather than removing them — a rail that reflows mid-tap is a mis-tap |
| loading | E2 category rail | ✅ covered | Prerendered with the page; no loading state exists |
| error | E2 category rail | ⊘ dismissed | **Reason:** the rail is derived at prerender from the same section data as the list; it has no independent fetch and therefore no independent failure mode |
| populated | E2 category rail | ✅ covered | Sticky horizontal rail, `jumpTo()` eased scroll to the section anchor |
| partial | E2 category rail | ✅ covered | Greyed-out empty sections *are* the partial state — the filter changes which sections have content, not which exist |
| overflow | E2 category rail | ✅ covered | Horizontal scroll with hidden scrollbars |
| zero-one-many | E2 category rail | ✅ covered | A single-section menu hides the rail — at one jump target it is pure chrome. 2+ renders it. Consistent with E5 and E8's hide-at-one rule |
| long-text | E2 category rail | 🧪 backstop | { statement: "A long category name does not force the rail to wrap or clip; it scrolls horizontally like any other overflow", verification: backstop } |
| empty | E3 item detail sheet | ✅ covered | A dish with no description, nutrition or variants renders name + price + allergens + disclaimer only — absent blocks are omitted, never stubbed |
| loading | E3 item detail sheet | ✅ covered | Sheet content ships in the prerendered payload; opening it triggers no fetch |
| error | E3 item detail sheet | ⊘ dismissed | **Reason:** no fetch on open, so there is no failure path to design for |
| populated | E3 item detail sheet | ✅ covered | Documented content order: image → name → description → variants → price → nutrition → allergens → disclaimer |
| partial | E3 item detail sheet | ✅ covered | Absent nutrition grid and absent variant rows are omitted entirely; the sheet does not reserve or stub them |
| overflow | E3 item detail sheet | ✅ covered | `max-height: 88dvh` with internal scroll; the sheet never exceeds the viewport |

## Registry Safety

| Registry | Blocks Used | Safety Gate |
|----------|-------------|-------------|
| shadcn official (`radix-nova`) | `select`, `radio-group`, `switch`, `field`, `tabs`, `tooltip`, `separator` (transitive via `field`) | not required |
| Third-party | **none declared** | n/a — no third-party registry vetting gate triggered |

`components.json` declares `"registries": {}` — **verified this session, empty.** No third-party
registry is configured, so the vetting gate does not apply to this phase.

**Registry items are source, not dependencies.** `shadcn add` copies `.tsx` files into
`components/ui/` where they become repo code. **Review the seven added files as code in the diff,
not as a lockfile bump.** All six declare `cssVars: false`, `css: false`, `tailwind: false` —
verified per item — so none will mutate `app/globals.css` mid-migration. All six import from
`radix-ui`, already installed. **This phase adds zero npm dependencies.**

Two mechanical notes: the raw registry JSON contains `IconPlaceholder` imports which the CLI
substitutes with the configured `lucide` library on install — **do not "fix" them by hand.** And the
`radix-nova` style is young; **re-verify `toast`'s 404 and `field`'s `label` dependency before the
add**, as the registry findings carry a 2026-08-11 validity date.

## Decisions Taken By This Contract

`01.1-RESEARCH.md` left seven questions open and recommended an answer for each. All seven are
**decided here** on the researcher's recommendation, so the planner inherits a contract rather than
a question. Reverse any of them here rather than downstream.

| RQ | Question | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| OQ3 | Venue colour control shape | `resolveVenueTheme()` is a **total function that derives** text tokens rather than accepting them — works for both a curated palette and a free-hex picker, and makes the exhaustive sweep a bonus rather than a dependency |
| OQ4 | Does SC1 mean "no third-party asset" literally? | **Allowlist with exactly one entry** + inline ACCT-01 justification |
| OQ5 | Does "all 16 primitives" include `alert`/`avatar`/`dropdown-menu`? | **Re-skin all 19.** Noted here so a verifier reads neither scope creep nor under-delivery |
| OQ6 | What phone control height satisfies SC3? | **44px floor on every control on every surface**, decided in the **token wave** |
| OQ7 | Does the allergen gap belong to 01.1 or Phase 3? | **Vocabulary (14 × 3 languages) in 01.1; filtering in Phase 3** |
| OQ8 | Are status colours Cena-fixed or venue-themable? | **Cena-fixed, permanently, on every surface** — and permanently in the contrast sweep |
| OQ9 | Does the QR payload encode the language? | **Yes** — `/menu/[slug]/[defaultLang]`. Free now, a migration later |

### Open, and deliberately not decided here

- **The exact imported ramp hexes.** Not retrievable this session; the fetch contract is in
  `## Contrast Guardrail Contract`. The one confirmed value, `--szeged-700 #0B5FA5`, is used verbatim.
- **Unknown-venue / unknown-table diner copy.** Phase 2 owns routing; no row exists yet.
- **Whether a Cena-branded diner menu should honour `prefers-color-scheme`.** The original D-10
  rationale was voided by the revised D-02. No standing answer; flagged to the theming milestone.
- **Native-speaker review of the HU/RO strings.**
